thread:
taylor: seeing private sidepanel preview show the wrong org's project card after a rapid org-switch. repro is consistent on canary.

sasha: steps pls?

taylor: repro steps:
1) sign in as alice@org-42
2) rapid switch (topbar) -> org-77
3) open sidepanel preview
4) UI header still shows org-42 but card content is for org-77

curl example for prefetch call:
```
curl -H "X-Org-ID: org-42" -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." https://console.canary.redwood.internal/sidepanel/prefetch
```
PR merged yesterday: #789 (prefetch key normalizer).

kevin: saw correlated logs: `sidepanel:prefetch cache-key=org-42|panel:123 served_to=org-77` — looks like normalizer dropped the intended target org in the fallback path.

maria: my hunch: cache-key normalization + router fallback path. The preflight routing policy will tunnel to the proxy which strips X-Workspace/X-Org headers in some code paths; prefetch uses session workspace as a fallback. Race when session update lags can mix keys.

sasha: i jammed a quick guard in local repro: `if (req.headers['x-workspace'] !== session.workspace) { return 412 }` — prevents cross-org content but i'm worried about perf/edge cases. :grimacing: 

ops-bot: Build 789 deployed to canary at 2025-11-15T12:23:00Z :rocket:

kevin: short-term patch: always include canonical `X-Org-ID` in cache key; only fallback to session.workspace if header missing. Also scrub any org headers on responses before they hit the client. opening PR 802 with the change.

taylor: repro payload for logs (copied from request body):
```
{"session_workspace":"org-42","prefetch_target":"org-77","panel_id":123}
```

maria: telemetry/billing impact: we observed quota increments for org-77 when requests originated as org-42. Need to reconcile attribution and add a metric alert when attribution mismatch ratio > 1%. This could be silently billing other orgs.

sasha: plan: @kevin push patch PR 802, @sasha add unit + e2e (rapid-switch simulation), @taylor validate on canary. If we can't get a clean fix by EOD we'll rollback PR 789. 👍

taylor: ack. i'll watch telemetry. if >5 mismatches in 15m i'll trigger rollback and open an incident. :eyes:
